profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | AI | Full Stack | DevOps
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 14+ years of experience building scalable AI-powered platforms, distributed systems, and high-performance backend applications for startups and enterprises. Proven expertise in system architecture, reliability, performance optimization, and end-to-end delivery, with a strong record of technical leadership across cross-functional teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Built scalable AI data pipelines, developed full-stack features with React and FastAPI, optimized backend performance and AWS infrastructure, led cross-functional teams, and implemented secure multi-tenant systems with authentication and audit logging
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Engineering · Internet Software

positions.title: Founding Software Engineer
positions.description: Architected and optimized web data extraction and distributed scraping platforms processing 1M+ pages daily, built LLM-assisted workflows to reduce manual maintenance, implemented QA tools to improve data quality, and collaborated with founders to launch automation features.

positions.title: Technical Tead
positions.description: Led development of AI-driven enterprise platforms with React, TypeScript, Python, and Node.js, architected scalable backend and cloud infrastructure

positions.title: Senior AI Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Built LLM-powered automation workflows, and guided engineering teams through planning, mentorship, and code quality improvements.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Led the architecture and development of AI-powered, HIPAA-compliant healthcare communication platforms — building scalable microservices, conversational AI workflows with LLM integration, and secure real-time infrastructure using Python, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Redis while mentoring engineers on distributed systems and AI best practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built and optimized scalable cloud-based enterprise platforms at using C#, .NET, Azure, and React — delivering high-performance APIs, reusable full-stack components, and streamlined CI/CD pipelines while contributing to architecture, mentorship, and cross-functional collaboration.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Delivered scalable, high-performance web applications at Bitovi by building reusable component systems, integrating REST APIs, and optimizing legacy codebases to drive 30%+ efficiency gains across enterprise and customer-facing projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Engineering · Mean Stack · Front-End Development
